title: safer mandolin
text: safer mandolin. Purchased this as a gift for a friend you has never owned a mandolin.  She recently had a very serious health incident and cannot stand for long periods - this cuts down the time she is standing tremendously and she tried it sitting as well.  She is amazed at how easy it is to use and to clean.  She cant believe she's lived all these years without one.  So grateful Amazon makes it easy for me to share wonderful things with friends and family!  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
